description: This file defines the RecurringBookingService class and related functions for creating and managing recurring bookings, including event firing and handling dependencies. It includes methods for creating bookings, rescheduling, and firing booking events, with detailed handling of booking data, audit logging, and external references.

classes.name: RecurringBookingService
classes.description: A service class responsible for creating, rescheduling, and firing events for recurring bookings, implementing IBookingService interface.

methods.name: fireBookingEvents
methods.description: Handles firing booking creation or rescheduling events, including audit logging and error handling.

methods.name: createBooking
methods.description: Creates a new recurring booking by invoking handleNewRecurringBooking with provided data.

methods.name: rescheduleBooking
methods.description: Reschedules an existing recurring booking by invoking handleNewRecurringBooking with provided data.
